_comment: Exact versions used by fp_reporting (May 2026). Merge these into your target app's package.json. Versions are pinned to reproduce the look 1:1 — Tailwind 3.x is required (4.x changes how CSS variables are consumed).

required._icons: Used by every component in /ui and /layout
required._radix_primitives: Required by the shadcn UI files in components/ui/. Install only the ones you actually use — each /ui/<name>.tsx imports from its matching @radix-ui/react-<name>.

optional._comment: Pull these in only if you use the matching primitives (date-picker, calendar, command palette, etc.)

install_one_liner: npm i next@^14.2.33 react@^18.2.0 react-dom@^18.2.0 tailwindcss@^3.4.1 tailwindcss-animate@^1.0.7 autoprefixer@^10.4.17 postcss@^8.4.35 class-variance-authority@^0.7.0 clsx@^2.1.0 tailwind-merge@^2.2.1 zustand@^4.5.0 lucide-react@^0.330.0 @radix-ui/react-accordion@^1.2.12 @radix-ui/react-alert-dialog@^1.1.15 @radix-ui/react-checkbox@^1.0.4 @radix-ui/react-collapsible@^1.1.12 @radix-ui/react-dialog@^1.1.15 @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu@^2.0.6 @radix-ui/react-label@^2.0.2 @radix-ui/react-popover@^1.0.7 @radix-ui/react-progress@^1.0.3 @radix-ui/react-scroll-area@^1.0.5 @radix-ui/react-select@^2.0.0 @radix-ui/react-separator@^1.0.3 @radix-ui/react-slot@^1.0.2 @radix-ui/react-tabs@^1.0.4 @radix-ui/react-toast@^1.1.5 @radix-ui/react-tooltip@^1.0.7
